text:
ashley_support: FYI customer c-901 reports their embeddings ingestion started failing after we applied a pin to model 'redwood-embed-v2.1'. They say vectors are coming back as 1536 dims but their index expects 1024. request id req-0a1b2c attached.

michael_eng: ugh. do we have a reproducer/curl from the customer? curious if client is requesting an alias vs a pinned variant.

ashley_support: pasted the minimal repro they gave: 
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{"input":"hello world","model":"redwood-embed"}' \\
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```
They were using the model name without the pinned suffix; but their config in account is pinned to redwood-embed@2026-03-01 (customer-facing pin).

michael_eng: ok. two quick checks: 1) confirm what model the runtime actually served (variant id + commit hash) 2) look at response shape header/logs. do we include embed dim in logs?

embed-bot: INFO: req=req-0a1b2c served_by=node-13 variant=redwood-embed-large@sha256:9f3a dim=1536 kernel=triton batch_size=8

raj_oncall: that log is telling — even though customer pinned to @2026-03-01, smart routing fell back to redwood-embed-large (1536) due to capacity constraints on the pinned variant. fallback should have been compatible but it is not the same vector width. looks like our fallback table doesn't enforce embedding-dim compatibility. (:eyes:)

maya_infra: confirmed. routing policy had a fallback mapping to the larger variant for throughput reasons. the compatibility check currently only verifies \"tokenizer / arch\" not embed width.

michael_eng: possible repro locally: hit pinned variant until it's saturated then trigger fallback path. might reproduce shape swap only under sustained QPS + batching. batching + batchpad can mix outputs if variant widths differ and we rely on pad/truncate heuristics — that would explain intermittent spikes.

maya_infra: quick mitigation: I pushed a rule to the routing layer to deny fallbacks where model.metadata.embedding_dim != pinned.metadata.embedding_dim. If mismatch, route to a lower-capacity fallback tier or return 429 to force client backoff. Deployed to edge canary.

ashley_support: I told the customer to temporarily unpin (or pin to the 1536 variant) while we fix the invariant. they're asking for ETA.

raj_oncall: next steps: (1) immediate hotfix applied by maya to block incompatible fallbacks (done, rolled to canary) (2) michael to add a server-side validation that asserts response vector length == model.metadata.embedding_dim and logs a clear error + returns 500 with code EMBED_DIM_MISMATCH (3) product to add embedding_dim in model manifest / public API for clarity.

michael_eng: starting a quick PR to add the response-length assert and an extra response header X-Embed-Dim for observability. local tests look good. i'll include a small e2e that simulates fallback with mixed variants to catch regressions.

embed-bot: ACTION: ticket #INF-4821 created: \"Reject incompatible embedding fallbacks; enforce embed dim invariant\" assigned to michael_eng.

maya_infra: also adding a short-term alert on the metrics: \"embedding.dim.mismatch.count\" -> pager if > 1/min per customer.

ashley_support: customer responded — they unpinned and ingestion resumed. they asked for a postmortem and for us to notify when permanent fix is live.

michael_eng: will follow up with a patch, e2e, and a release note. ETA for full rollout ~ 2 days (after code review).

raj_oncall: once patched, let's also run a query across logs to find any other customers affected in the last 7 days (search by EMBED_DIM_MISMATCH or by fallback variant mapping).

ashley_support: thanks team — I'll keep c-901 updated and mark as escalated. closing this thread when INF-4821 is resolved. :white_check_mark:
